_readme: Site glossary for en/ (v2, filled for the Home Assistant Cloudflared Web GUI site). shared = WoowTech series names and chrome terms reused across the 13 sites (seed, unchanged); terms = Cloudflare Tunnel / cloudflared / Home Assistant add-on domain terms — upstream wording wins; keepEnglish = never translate or rephrase; forbid = words the reviewer rejects. decisions = the binding cross-chapter wording agreed before the 12 chapters were translated in parallel: every distinct section h2, every data-nav label, every callout opening label, every table header, the Chinese placeholders inside frozen code blocks, and the Taiwan-specific examples that policy=localize replaces. The plain-text mirror translators read is /home/user/out/terms_ha_cloudflare_tunnel.txt.
principles: Upstream English UI/docs wording wins (headscale.net, tailscale.com/kb).
Product names, CLI commands, config keys, file names, hostnames and placeholders stay verbatim; Chinese placeholders become <your-…> style.
US spelling; sentence case for headings, nav and buttons; Title Case for product and WoowTech series names.
Second person 'you'; direct, like a senior engineer onboarding a beginner; no 'In this chapter we will', no marketing adjectives, no emoji.
Callout labels are fixed: Concept: / Tip: / Warning: / Danger:; full-width punctuation becomes ASCII; 第 N 章 → Chapter N; 圖 N-M → Figure N-M.

For THIS site the upstream English wording comes from developers.cloudflare.com, home-assistant.io and the WOOWTECH Cloudflared Web GUI README/DOCS — the headscale.net / tailscale.com pointer in the first principle belongs to the sibling Headscale site and does not apply here.

Home Assistant renamed Add-ons to Apps in its English UI. This site's Chinese mixes App / Apps / add-on / 附加元件 for the same thing: render the software as 'add-on' in prose, and use 'Apps' / 'Add-ons' only when quoting a menu label the reader must find on screen.

Page names (Dashboard, Setup, Config, Logs), button labels (Save, Save & Restart, Reset, Restart Add-on, Open Web UI, Connect, Clear, Download), option keys (external_hostname, additional_hosts, tunnel_token, catch_all_service, log_level...) and status words (running / starting / stopped / unknown) stay verbatim in English.
Never call cert.pem a TLS or website certificate — it is the cloudflared account certificate. Never render 遮罩／遮蔽／遮密 as 'mask'; use 'redact'.

terms.repository ／ 套件來源 ／ 儲存庫 ／ Repositories: repository (Repositories when quoting the HA dialog)
terms.Dashboard: Dashboard (the page name; keep Title Case)
terms.Save ／ Save & Restart ／ Reset: Save / Save & Restart / Reset (button labels, verbatim)
terms.完整網址 ／ 完整 hostname: the full URL / the full hostname
terms.running ／ starting ／ stopped ／ unknown: running / starting / stopped / unknown (status words stay verbatim)
terms.網段: network range (a CIDR range) — never 'tailnet' on this site
terms.入站連接埠轉送 ／ port forwarding ／ 開埠: inbound port forwarding / open a port
terms.本機退路 ／ 本地復原入口: a local fallback / local recovery path

SSL certificate (for cert.pem — it is the account certificate)
tunnel token (two words, when the option key tunnel_token is meant)

decisions._readme: Binding cross-chapter wording. If a chapter can render a phrase two ways, use the form here. h2_exact covers every distinct <h2> on the site (chapter sections keyed by their exact Chinese string); entries for sales.html / prompts.html / skills.html are the default forms — those pages are policy transcreate/rewrite, so a section that is genuinely rewritten may depart from them, but a section that survives must use them. Nothing here may drift between chapters.

h2_by_section.why: chapter-specific; translate the Chinese h2 literally. ch10/ch11/ch12 literally say 為什麼要學這個, which lands on the fixed form 'Why this matters'; ch1-ch9 have their own image-led h2 and keep it.
h2_by_section.concept: chapter-specific; translate literally. The data-nav label (Core concepts / Mode basics / ...) is separate.
h2_by_section.steps: <Number> steps to <verb phrase> — keep the Chinese numeral (六步 = Six steps, 七步 = Seven steps, 八步 = Eight steps). ch8/ch9/ch11/ch12 have no numeral: translate their h2 literally.
h2_by_section.test: chapter-specific; 驗收 = acceptance check, 驗收測試 = acceptance tests, 驗收表 = acceptance table, 驗收清單 = acceptance checklist
h2_by_section.troubleshoot: Common <topic> pitfalls (e.g. Common install pitfalls, Common Logs page pitfalls)
h2_by_section.faq: <Topic> FAQ where the Chinese names a topic (安裝常見問題 = Install FAQ); bare 常見問題 = FAQ
h2_by_section.sources: Official sources and version notes — identical in all 12 chapters
